bio_en: Gerasim Balayan was born in Shushi in 1880, finished the town school and joined the ARF young, serving on its committee and in 1905 commanding the 5th district of the Shushi self-defence during the Armenian-Tatar clashes. Arrested on suspicion after an assassination in 1909, he was exiled in 1910 and then held in Novocherkassk among the Dashnaks gathered by the investigator Lyzhin for the great ARF trial in Petrograd, at which he was acquitted. He later lived in France, where he directed the ARF central archive and museum at Montmorency (opened 1936). He died on 6 November in hospital after a short illness.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year not given in the portion read.
